# `core/EntitySystem.js`

> **Source:** `engine/core/EntitySystem.js`

EntitySystem — lightweight entity registry used by LIFE narrative systems. This is intentionally a simple in-memory map. The ECS runtime lives in the engine simulation layer; narrative modules just need a stable handle to the active entity collection they are narrating.
